blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-10-01 at Optimism block 157619450 and Base block 52024165. Pinned runtime bytecode exactly matched the respective Blockscout verified-source deployments; EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots were zero. Both sources expose standard ERC-20 transfer paths, role-gated mint, and allowance-gated burnFrom, but no pause, blacklist, freeze, allowlist, seizure, transfer hook, or privileged arbitrary-holder burn. Direct JPYT blacklistability remains false. Locked USDC/USDT remain upstream freeze exposures that can impair backing or redemption, not powers to restrict JPYT holder balances.

oracleRisk.summary: Optimism issuance reads Chainlink-style USDT/USD and JPY/USD feeds; Base issuance reads a Chainlink-style USDC/USD feed and Pyth USD/JPY. At Base block 52075154, pythValidTimePeriod() was 31,536,000 seconds. The managers reject non-positive deposit-token feed answers without checking their timestamps; no independent oracle fallback is implemented in the reviewed sources.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex external-a oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: JPYT has no borrower-specific undercollateralized positions or liquidation branches. Its per-chain deposit managers calculate issuance from the deposit token and JPY exchange rate: the current Optimism implementation uses Chainlink-style aggregators, while the current Base implementation uses a Chainlink-style USDC/USD aggregator and Pyth USD/JPY. Redemptions use accumulated deposit-token/JPYT conversion rates. These are price-sensitive top-level issuance and redemption authorities; the Base Pyth path is not a redundant fallback.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: JPYT has two independent native liabilities, on Optimism and Base. At the 2026-10-09 pins each token has exactly one MINTER_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE holder: its local DepositManager. Verified managers mint local JPYT against USDT or USDC deposited into Aave and burn holder-authorized JPYT on withdrawal; neither locks canonical JPYT to issue another-chain receipt. Aave collateral custody and pending collateral withdrawals are not canonical-JPYT bridge escrow. Both exact token deployments are six-decimal Dephaser JPY / JPYT ERC-20s.
